text:
lauren: Heads-up — I’m going to flip on the hidden console flag for the assistant preferences beta for a small canary. goal: validate guardrails (opt-outs, telemetry) before wider exposure.

sam: which flag name and scope? can we limit to internal + 5% external orgs?

lauren: flag: `console.hidden_assistant_prefs`
canary: 5% of orgs + all internal (redwood-internal). plan: 30m soak then evaluate metrics. command to enable (local FF tool):
```
ffctl enable console.hidden_assistant_prefs --canary 5 --groups redwood-internal,beta-orgs
```
PR: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/4820 (contains gating + telemetry hooks)

devon: I added server-side fallback (returns old prefs UI) if KV cache misses > 3% to avoid bad experiences. also added a feature-gated metric `assistant_prefs.render_error_count`.

maria: can we ensure the console routes still show the correct telemetry flag so Optimize can pick it up? I’ll add a short eval set for preference flows.

kevin: reviewers? pinging @devon @sam @lauren for code review. I can take deployment once we have approvals.

priya (support): please draft a one-paragraph note for support with: how to detect affected customers, opt-out steps, and logging hints. I’ll prep a canned response.

sam: I’ll run the smoke script against staging after the PR merges. quick checklist:
- confirm toggle respects user-level opt-out
- ensure no JS console errors in legacy browsers
- validate metrics appear in staging Grafana dashboard (dashboard: Console > Assistant Prefs)

lauren: thanks. also guardrail: auto-disable if `assistant_prefs.render_error_count` > 10 in 15m window or if median latency to load prefs > 1.2s for 10% of requests. ops rule in the PR.

devon: added alert policy + a synthetic user flow that hits prefs every 2m. alert channel: #eng-oncall and #product.

kevin: added `@oncall` to the rollout notes. I’ll wait for approvals and then trigger the canary.

lauren: timeline: merge+deploy at 09:30 PT, enable canary at 09:45, then 30m soak. if green -> escalate to 25% at 11:00, 100% tomorrow morning.

sam: note for reviewers — there’s a small UX tweak in the PR that hides the advanced setting behind `console.hidden_assistant_prefs` (no layout changes). quick review appreciated.

priya (support): also request product to share the public-facing comms snippet so I can put it in the internal KB.

lauren: @maria can you draft a 1-2 line comms for customers (and a brief internal note) and drop it here?

maria: on it, will post in thread in 15m.

deploy-bot: [deploy] console-service v3.14.2 queued by kevin. CI: all checks passed. ETA: ~6m.

kevin: deployed to canary shard at 09:36 PT. enabling flag in 60s.

sam: smoke tests running now. first pass looks okay, prefs load + toggle preserved. no console errors in chrome/firefox.

lauren: stopping here for now — if anyone sees anything odd after the first 30m call it out. I’ll post back after the soak with metrics snapshot. :thumbsup:
